customManagers.description: flake.nix pins the devShell's pnpm to the registry tarball version; it must equal packageManager.

packageRules.description: Non-major updates automerge when the required finish check passes.
Major updates are manual by default because they can require code changes.
Automerge npm devDependency majors when finish passes. Renovate identifies pnpm catalog entries by catalog name. Petalboard also uses the dev catalog's prisma as a runtime dependency.

matrix-sdk-sqlite requires a specific rusqlite and Cargo allows one libsqlite3-sys links version, so rusqlite moves only with matrix-sdk (#290 pinned 0.40; #512 wanted 0.42 and could not resolve). Lift when matrix-sdk-sqlite accepts a newer rusqlite.

The Dart package, the Rust crate and the generated bindings (apps/point/app/rust/src/frb_generated.rs) must be one version, and Renovate does not regenerate the bindings. Bump together and run flutter_rust_bridge_codegen on the branch before merging.
OkHttp 5.5 requires compileSdk 37 and apps/janet-call-android compiles against 35; #705 broke its build. Lift this with the compileSdk bump.
Compose BOM 2026 (compose 1.12) needs Android Gradle plugin 9.1 and a newer compileSdk, so #742 broke the build of apps/janet-call-android. Lift this with the plugin and compileSdk bump.

One Node.js everywhere: devEngines, every Dockerfile FROM node:, and @types/node move in a single PR that automerges. recreateWhen always keeps a branch whose update was already merged (by hand or by an earlier PR) from being stranded with automerge disabled.

One pnpm everywhere: packageManager, the CI pnpm/setup read of it, and the two flake.nix tarball URLs move in a single PR, so the devShell never lags CI. Not automerged: flake.nix changes need `nix flake lock` before they merge (nix re-locks a changed input URL on the first `nix develop`).
oxlint, @effect/tsgo and tsrs must move together (effect-tsgo drives both); a split update breaks the type-aware lint.
effect-qb 0.24.2 (latest) peers on effect >=4.0.0 <4.1.0, so effect 4.1.x cannot install under strict peers (#579). Lift when effect-qb widens its peer range.
adapter-node 6 peers on SvelteKit 3 and 5.x peers on Kit 2, so neither can move alone (#561/#643 had to be one change).
